problem_type: Operation-specific plan review lost during host replacement
symptom: Default safe-auto immediately writes a storyboard plan or batch patch without showing the required review card.
direct_cause: The lane reads only capability-level requiresPlanReview; canvas.write has mixed operations, and the old host's renderer-owned storyboard guard was not represented in that contract.
class_root: Operation-specific review and reuse facts are encoded in a retiring caller instead of the shared capability owner.
affected_population: Calls with existing canvas session grants
internal_only_reason: Nomi's former coordinator explicitly excluded renderer-owned propose/patch calls before its safe-auto and session-grant test. The existing shared capability policy is the correct owner of this product review boundary.
invariants: Every whole-plan or batch-patch storyboard write requires a fresh user review in every approval mode.
A canvas session grant cannot bypass or be minted by a non-reusable plan review.
Ordinary local canvas writes retain safe-auto behavior.
The lane derives review facts from capability and operation metadata, never a model-facing tool-name list.
generality_proof: A shared operation metadata resolver supplies the same requires-review and reuse facts to the generic policy for any model-facing name mapped to the capability.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Derive effective review requirements and reuse permission from the canonical contract and operation.
Make non-reusable plan review independent of approval mode and session grants.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Whole-plan replacement and patches declare allowReuse false; other canvas operations have no review override.
The gate consumes the shared derived facts through capability IDs and parsed operation arguments.
The shared hard gate runs before both project-mode and session-grant fast paths.

recurrence.reason: Every operation with mixed review semantics under one capability can be bypassed when a new caller reads only capability-level effects.
same_class_scan: Read old coordinator renderer-owned storyboard guard before safeApprovalGranted.
Inspected canvas operation effect maps, timeline requiresPlanReview, registry alias lookup, Lane subjectOf and shared grant policy.

prevention.invariant: Operation-declared fresh review cannot be bypassed by mode, grant or tool alias.
prevention.failure_mode: With UI the tool waits on a non-grantable card; without UI it is denied before any domain write.
prevention.strategy: Declare review facts once in the capability contract and derive the shared approval subject.

legacy_paths.rationale: The old renderer-owned predicate derives its operation membership from the canonical metadata instead of maintaining another operation list; the old host is removed by the atomic cutover.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: The SDK's before_tool hook works correctly; the missing review fact belongs to Nomi's capability contract.

migration: No stored format changes. Existing session grants remain incapable of satisfying a fresh plan review.
residual_risks: The real Electron review-card appearance is verified by the parent production walkthrough; these tests prove the actual SDK-to-domain write gate.

invariant_owner_layer.why: The earliest shared approval boundary can prevent the same bypass across current and future tool names and host adapters.
